Rolling-origin CV for Tucker4 coherent forecast

Source: R/tucker4.R
cv_rolling_origin_tucker4.Rd

Rolling-origin CV for Tucker4 coherent forecast

Usage

cv_rolling_origin_tucker4(
  X_ilr,
  mx_all,
  mx_disease_list,
  disease_order,
  years,
  R_A,
  R_B,
  R_C,
  R_D,
  ts_method,
  h_val = 3,
  min_train = 12,
  metric_fn = compute_mase_array
)

Arguments

X_ilr

4D ILR array.

mx_all

3D all-cause array.

mx_disease_list

Named list of 3D disease arrays.

disease_order

Character vector.

years

Integer vector.

R_A, R_B, R_C, R_D

Tucker4 ranks.

ts_method

Time-series method.

h_val

Validation horizon.

min_train

Minimum training years.

metric_fn

Scoring function with signature function(arr_test, fc_arr, arr_train). Default: compute_mase_array().

Value

Scalar mean CV score.
